column1: Table 5. Calibration and 90%-sensitivity referral within and across cohorts (osteoporosis against the rest).

Note: External rows: model fitted on the whole source cohort and applied without recalibration, with the source cohort threshold. Internal referral thresholds were set inside each training part. Shrunk rows: coefficients multiplied by the expected shrinkage factor and the intercept re-estimated (no CI computed); the internal shrunk slope of 1.00 follows almost by construction (0.85/0.85), so the external slope is the informative check.
